company_name: Chengdu ArTech Specialty Graphite Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium - Chengdu ArTech Specialty Graphite Co., Ltd. supplies carbon and graphite products that are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in high-temperature and electrical vacuum furnaces.
summary: Chengdu ArTech Specialty Graphite Co., Ltd. specializes in machining and supplying carbon and graphite items that are essential for various industrial applications, including the semiconductor sector.
